description: This file defines the interface and event handling functions for integrating Redis asynchronous context with an event loop, specifically using the 'ae' event library. It includes function implementations for adding, deleting, and cleaning up read/write events, and attaching Redis async contexts to the event loop.

methods.name: redisAeReadEvent
methods.description: Handles read events by calling redisAsyncHandleRead on the context.

methods.name: redisAeWriteEvent
methods.description: Handles write events by calling redisAsyncHandleWrite on the context.

methods.name: redisAeAddRead
methods.description: Registers the file descriptor for read events in the event loop.

methods.name: redisAeDelRead
methods.description: Removes the read event registration for the file descriptor.

methods.name: redisAeAddWrite
methods.description: Registers the file descriptor for write events in the event loop.

methods.name: redisAeDelWrite
methods.description: Removes the write event registration for the file descriptor.

methods.name: redisAeCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the redisAeEvents structure, removing events and freeing memory.

methods.name: redisAeAttach
methods.description: Attaches a redisAsyncContext to an event loop, setting up event handlers.
